> A practical AI adoption guide, written by practical AI adopters. Learn how to adopt AI across your organization, with case studies, maturity levels, and lessons from the Protocol Institute and other organizations.

## Maturity levels (5)

- **L1 Shadow** — AI is in use. The organization doesn't know how, by whom, or with what data.
- **L2 Sanctioned** — The organization has granted AI access. It hasn't designed what to do with it.
- **L3 Engine** — AI workflows are designed, not improvised. The business model depends on them.
- **L2–3 Sanctioned → Engine** — You have the foundations of Level 3. Consistency and measurement are missing.
- **L3–4 Engine → Infrastructure** — Your organization is at the leading edge. The next challenge is sector-level, not organizational.

## Archetypes (10) from the assessment

- **The Vanguard** — *"Someone has to go first. We'd rather learn hard than wait safe."*
- **The Traveller** — *"We didn't add AI to our business. AI is why the business exists."*
- **The Architect** — *"We're not chasing the latest model. We're building the platform our teams will run on for years."*
- **The Integrator** — *"We're not first. We're not lost. We adopt where it pays and redesign when it matters."*
- **The Tinkerer** — *"We don't know what will work until we try it. So we try a lot of things."*
- **The Ratifier** — *"We don't surf the first wave. We ship the one that lasts."*
- **The Warden** — *"Our industry doesn't move until the regulator does. That's the job."*
- **The Broker** — *"We know what we need. Someone else is better at holding the tools."*
- **The Folkway** — *"AI showed up through our teams before leadership noticed. We're still figuring out what that means."*
- **The Guild** — *"Our best people figured it out themselves. The rest of the org doesn't know yet."*
